Gautam Gambhir advises young cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to be patient

Cricketer Gautam Gambhir has advised young player Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to be patient and wait for his opportunity. Sooryavanshi had reportedly played backup to experienced performers Abhishek Sharma and Sanju Samson during a series in Sri Lanka. Gambhir's comments suggest Sooryavanshi must bide his time as more experienced players are currently ahead of him in the team.
